video_title: Carmelo Anthony and Jeremy Lin Finally Break Silence on 'Linsanity', the Knicks Exit & Their Issues

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the challenges of his rookie year and imposter syndrome
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't a background where anybody ever said you can make the NBA, or that was never a reality.
quotes.quote: My rookie year, I had a horrible year because I had imposter syndrome. I didn't come from a background where anybody ever said you can make the NBA, or that was never a reality. It was like, you're crazy. You think you can make the NBA? So for me to actually be in that space, I was like, oh, I made it.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the difficulty of blending his and Carmelo Anthony's playing styles
quotes.excerpt: I am a pick and roll player, ball heavy, ball dominant, and you are maybe the best mid-post isolation score.
quotes.quote: I am a pick and roll player, ball heavy, ball dominant, and you are maybe the best mid-post isolation score. Not to say that's the only thing that you can do, but you are elite, elite, elite at that. And so these two styles are realistically not something that is going to naturally mesh, so you got to work on meshing at it.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the lack of alignment within the Knicks organization during Linsanity
quotes.excerpt: Ownership is unsure, front office is kind of split, coaching staff is split, and players are split.
quotes.quote: Ownership is unsure, front office is kind of split, coaching staff is split, and players are split. Because we're trying to figure out what direction is this ship going in, and looking back, it's like, actually, we could have coexisted if we had the time and the intentionality to figure it out.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on his contract offer from the Houston Rockets and the Knicks' reaction
quotes.excerpt: Melo said that my contract was ridiculous because I had signed a three years, 25 million with the Rockets.
quotes.quote: Melo said that my contract was ridiculous because I had signed a three years, 25 million with the Rockets that the Knicks had an opportunity to match. And the structure of the contract, which Melo, you can speak on that on your own for yourself, what you had shared to me over the phone, but I'm piecing together all these stories.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on why he never spoke publicly about leaving the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I've actually never spoken publicly about my exit from the New York Knicks until today.
quotes.quote: I've actually never spoken publicly about my exit from the New York Knicks until today. And the only reason why is because now we have had that conversation. And so for me, it's like, I'm sitting there like, I got to go back to New York. We got to find any which way.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on his reluctance to accept the Houston Rockets' contract offer
quotes.excerpt: I get on the phone with my agent and I'm like, I don't want to take it.
quotes.quote: I go to Houston. Houston gives me this offer and I'm like, I swear to you, I get on the phone with my agent and I'm like, I don't want to take it. He's like, you don't have a choice. He's like, there's no other offer from the other 29 teams. You don't have a choice. Do you want to be in the NBA or not?

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the financial and professional impact of his exit from the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: My exit from the New York Knicks crushed me. I was messed up because I wasn't going back.
quotes.quote: My exit from the New York Knicks crushed me. I was messed up because I wasn't going back to New York, but because of how it happened. But from my side, I'm thinking like, yo, there is no other player in the NBA that made that much money in that short amount of time.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on his regret about not having earlier conversations with teammates
quotes.excerpt: I wish we had the conversation a lot earlier because it's hilarious, I've never told you this.
quotes.quote: I wish we had the conversation a lot earlier because it's hilarious, I've never told you this. Obviously I leave the Knicks and we never talked it out. And so there's this like elephant in the room. So every time we play against each other, I'm like, I'll say what's up to you if you say what's up to me and you're probably like, I'll say what's up to you because and so we never say what's up to each other.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin and Carmelo Anthony on the current Knicks' team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: The current Knicks are balling and they're bringing people together.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: Why are we here? Why am I at 7:00 p.m.? Why do we get that conversation? It's because the current Knicks are balling and they're bringing people together. That has always been the beauty of sports.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: There's hundreds of thousands of Knicks fans right now that are healing just watching you two talk.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on seeking professional help for career trauma
quotes.excerpt: There was trauma from early in my career that I wasn't able to get past.
quotes.quote: I went to therapy around this. I had a sports psychologist around this because there was trauma from early in my career that I wasn't able to get past to get to that next level as a player and I needed professional help. How do I trust people? How do I not feel like the other shoe is going to drop?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony and Jeremy Lin on the 'Linsanity' reconciliation
quotes.excerpt: I want my story to be my story, not Jeremy's story.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: I visualized the reconciliation. I told you this over the phone too. I've been praying for you for years because I want my story to be my story, not Jeremy's story and by the way, let's talk bad about somebody else or blame somebody else. I just want to be me.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: I'm a no-drama guy. I want to be cool with all my teammates, I want to have fun and hoop.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Charles Barkley's viral Hasidic Jews comment
quotes.excerpt: I seen Hasidic Jews break dancing with Black kids. This is the greatest unification of the city.
quotes.quote: Charles Barkley had a quote recently while he was taking in media day for the New York Knicks and said, 'I seen Hasidic Jews break dancing with Black kids. This is the greatest unification of the city since 9/11.' And everybody thought he was lying. And then this link dropped.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony and Jeremy Lin on Charles Barkley's Cardi B comments
quotes.excerpt: Shaq is glued to Cardi B! Chill, focus Shaq.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Shaq is glued to Cardi B! Chill, focus Shaq.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on teaching young players his signature moves
quotes.excerpt: There's two things that I literally teach these young players, I'm like, 'Watch Melo.'
quotes.quote: There's two things that I literally teach these young players, I'm like, 'Watch Melo.' And so you are actually somebody that I'm like, 'The next generation, y'all got to watch, y'all got to pick up these two moves.'

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin explains his signature hesitation and spin moves
quotes.excerpt: You got your right foot in the air and then you plant it so fast.
quotes.quote: It's the one where you catch it and then you pretend like you're going to drive and then you just you take you you so you got your right foot in the air and then you plant it so fast like you're thinking you're about to drive but then you just bam right up and then the ball is up and out while you're on the way up and the defender is literally trying to process it and you're already shooting a smooth jumper. And the other one is that spin move where you take almost like a fake dribble left but you're really right into his chest and then quick spin.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the importance of open communication
quotes.excerpt: If it took 14 years to sit on this couch and hash that out and talk.
quotes.quote: If it took 14 years to sit on this couch and hash that out and talk or if it took me taking some time out to just spend two hours with you on the phone and really answering the questions that you had, right, these was questions that was built up for 14 years that other people probably was adding on to your pressures and your mindset and your perspective. It took me to go through what I went through to have the time to come back and be at peace with being able to answer all your questions with actual facts.
